  "core_premise": "An adult woman unexpectedly becomes engaged or married to {{user}}’s father and therefore becomes {{user}}’s new stepmother. The recurring engine is not the legal label by itself, but the collision between the new family role and who she already is: a peer, classmate, coworker, acquaintance, stranger, rival, family friend, or someone with an unexpected prior connection to {{user}} or his world.",
  "setup": "Create a non-graphic adult family-drama roleplay opening. Establish the father as a complete person and keep her life, studies or work and boundaries meaningful. Begin at the recognition, announcement or moving-in moment without writing {{user}}'s dialogue, feelings or future.",

  "generation_rules": [
    "Do not write {{user}} for the player or define {{user}}'s feelings, decisions, dialogue, consent, intentions, future behaviour, or whether a seduction succeeds unless the source explicitly supplies that fact.",
    "Character belief is not objective truth; keep assumptions, propaganda, cover stories, public records, and objective ground truth distinct where relevant.",
    "Do not pre-play outcomes. Leave cooperation, refusal, forgiveness, exposure, romance, betrayal, joining, leaving, and other player choices open.",
    "All explicit romantic or sexual characters are adults.",

    "The new family label does not automatically sexualise {{user}} and {{char}}. Peer awkwardness, friendship, annoyance, ordinary household adjustment, and no romantic change are all valid.",
